src: Josh Lloyd shows, read by hand

ace bailey.note: Josh had him queued at 151 in his pick 7 mock before another drafter took him

aj dybantsa.note: His biggest fade, he projects him near 180 but says a flyer in the 130 to 150 range is fine, so the draft target is used here

ajay mitchell.note: Josh came away let down by his preseason and worries his production last year leaned on injuries to others

andrew nembhard.note: Josh says he stopped targeting him since the injury means he misses the start of the season

andrew wiggins.note: With Giannis taking the ball, his share shrinks and his hot shooting last year looks like a fluke. Josh keeps him out of his top 100 and prefers upside swings near 120

ayo dosunmu.note: Josh took him at 135 and said he once had him near 108, so the bench worry is priced in by then

ben simmons.note: Torn Achilles ends his season and Josh says nobody should hold him now, so he falls off the board entirely

bobby portis.note: Miami is thin behind Bam and Giannis, so any injury could hand him big minutes. Josh likes him a bit more as a late stash

brandin podziemski.note: Josh drafted him at 90 in his pick 7 mock and thinks a top 70 finish is possible, so the draft target is 90

brandon ingram.note: On his do not draft list. Achilles tear, a slow healer, likely back around the holidays with minutes limits and rest days, so not in his top 120

brandon miller.note: Josh took him at 25 once LaMelo was gone and would have taken him at 36 in another mock. No rank given

cameron boozer.note: Strong preseason has Josh pushing him up. He was surprised Boozer was still there in the 50s and had him queued, but another manager took him first

coby white.note: Another calf strain, the fourth in about a year, drops him below the 90s for Josh even though he likes the player

collin gillespie.note: Josh doubts he is worth a pick in standard 12 team leagues outside stash formats

collin murray boyles.note: Josh wanted him at pick 88 in his pick 9 mock and missed by one, says he has liked him all offseason

damian lillard.note: Josh now sees a possible top 30 season yet still passes on him that early. His draft target was round 6, after pick 50

daniel gafford.note: Started for Dallas but managed two points in 22 minutes, Josh thinks he may be finished as a fantasy asset without a star feeding him

darius acuff.note: With Simmons gone Josh sees a little more value flowing to the rookie guard in Sacramento

davion mitchell.note: Josh calls him the biggest Heat fade. Very low usage, weak defensive stats, may not even start. A round 15 pick at most

dayron sharpe.note: Josh took him in round 7 of his pick 7 mock and admitted it was a touch early

dejounte murray.note: Still his best Pelicans target, but Josh no longer sees top 30 upside. He expects a top 50 finish if the minutes hold

demar derozan.note: Josh sees only about 25 minutes in Denver and does not think that is enough for standard league value

derik queen.note: Played only as the backup center behind Missi in 18 minutes, Josh calls the outlook bleak but will hold in many leagues for now

donovan clingan.note: Josh calls the 60s or 70s a fair price and says he is boards and blocks only. Too high where the sites have him

dylan harper.note: Josh moved him up a lot and now leans toward Harper winning a starting job in San Antonio. He calls a fall into the mid 70s a slide

gui santos.note: Looks like an opening night starter for the Warriors, so Josh says to bump him up as a late pick. No rank given

jalen smith.note: With Claxton out two more weeks Josh now says grab him everywhere and thinks the bigger minutes could last all season

jaylen brown.note: Josh calls him the best Sixers target, likes him around pick 40 as more minutes offset lost usage, and took him at 39 in his pick 10 mock

jerami grant.note: Coming off the Memphis bench for about 26 minutes and Josh calls him not really worth a pick

jeremiah fears.note: Josh took him at 136 in his pick 9 mock as an upside swing after a good preseason game

josh hart.note: Josh says he will likely skip him in every draft this year, only taking a look if he slides to around 120

jrue holiday.note: Only 21 minutes off the Portland bench with low usage, Josh sees no place for him in 10 team leagues and calls him borderline in 12s

jusuf nurkic.note: Foot and toe trouble may cost weeks or months and a smaller role after, so Josh would only take him with the last pick as an IR stash

keegan murray.note: Josh is losing patience after a two point night on tiny usage and the blocks were missing, he will give it a few games

keldon johnson.note: Josh agrees he belongs outside the top 200 and expects a worse year buried in a crowded Spurs bench of forwards

kelel ware.note: Josh found his preseason poor and sees about 23 minutes with no clear starting job, though he would not cut him given the upside

kevin porter.note: Josh projects around 25 minutes in a crowded Milwaukee group, which he reckons is only just enough for 12 team leagues

keyonte george.note: Josh expects only a small dip from last year and puts him in the 40 to 55 band, well above where most drafts take him

khaman maluach.note: Josh projects a finish around 130 to 155 but is fine taking him in round 10 near 116, so that is the target

klay thompson.note: Likely starts on paper but in short stints. Josh sees only threes from him now and would not draft him anywhere in the top 300

kon knueppel.note: With the hamstring issue Josh now keeps him just outside his top 80, down from the 60s range he liked when healthy

kristaps porzingis.note: Josh says his health is too unclear to draft him right now

kyshawn george.note: Confirmed starter with strong defensive stats in camp, Josh says take him in the 110s as an established round ten type

mikal bridges.note: On his avoid list in every format, he says the low usage and missing free throws and defensive stats keep him outside his top 100

moussa diabate.note: Josh liked that he was the clear Charlotte starter at center with far more minutes than the backups, worth a swap for a fringe big

myles turner.note: Josh hoped to land him near pick 103 but saw him go earlier, mild bump up

nic claxton.note: Josh expects the hamstring to keep him out early, so he drops him just outside his top 100

nickeil alexander walker.show: Rankings that do not add up
nickeil alexander walker.note: Josh projects him around 35th with no real change in role, so Yahoo sliding him toward 58 is a gift in his eyes

paolo banchero.note: For cats Josh now likes him somewhere in the 50s or early 60s, much higher in Yahoo points, and calls him the top Magic target if he slides

paul george.note: Big opener in 38 minutes with no sign of a cap off the Achilles, Josh now sees top 30 to 40 per game value and would only sell for a top 40 return, injuries the main risk

reed sheppard.note: Josh is out on him after a 16 minute three point night, he thinks two Houston guards would need to get hurt before real minutes come

rui hachimura.note: Josh says for the first time he could see cutting him in category leagues even with 31 projected minutes for the Clippers

saddiq bey.note: Josh would not keep him, just 24 minutes and modest usage in a crowded Pelicans wing group with nothing else in his line

sandro mamukelashvili.note: Josh sees him as a fringe end of roster big after a quiet five shot night and is fine dropping him for Missi or Diabate

scoot henderson.note: Josh calls him his late round swing if he wins the starting job, though his confidence is low

stephen curry.note: After the practice scare Josh was ready to push him out of his top 40, then the injury turned out to be an ankle and he eased off a little

tari eason.note: Josh has him near 20 minutes behind a tight Houston top seven and thinks the late round bet on him will not pay off

tobias harris.note: Josh expects the calf strain to keep him out at the start, sees him as a bench forward and says skip him in 12 team leagues

toumani camara.note: Josh projects him around 130 to 140 but says he should not be drafted in 12 team leagues, so he slides below 150

trae young.note: Josh slots him at 33 overall since he sees fewer minutes and usage below 30 again, more a round three pick than a round two one

trey murphy.note: Josh took him with his own third round pick at 34 in a pick 10 mock, a bit above where his Pelicans preview left him

ty jerome.show: 9 cat mock pick 1 and ESPN points mock
ty jerome.note: Memphis is running a big share of the offense through him. Josh pushed him up, took him in round 5 of a points mock and says the low 60s is about right

tyrese maxey.note: Josh admits he is lower than most and would not be surprised by a finish in the middle to late teens with less of the ball

vj edgecombe.note: Josh sees him as the third option behind Maxey and Brown now, so his steals and usage should dip. Happy to take him around 90 but not in the 60s or 70s

yaxel lendeborg.note: Golden State looks set to start him, so Josh bumped him up and took him at pick 106

yves missi.note: Started at center for 30 minutes with big boards and 3 blocks, Josh says go grab him and thinks he was undervalued in drafts

zach edey.note: Josh says he feels more confident on him lately and grabbed him in round 5 of his pick 6 mock, earlier than his old 70s target

zach lavine.note: Josh notes a small value bump for him now that Simmons is out for Sacramento
